notes.title: CinemApocalypse
notes.content:
[b] Ladies and gentlemen, [/ b]
times are dark, and something smells strange in the air, doesn't it?
well, you better stay at home to keep watching good series and movies in your favorite app.

Let me introduce you to CinemApocalypse, a [b]VR app [/b]where you can load and [b]watch a movie [/b]while [b]playing a game[/b]!

The concept is a survival game where you will have to [b]kill zombies [/b]infecting the cinema, and if possible do not shoot the [b]civilians, save [/b]them, otherwise they will turn into zombies and try to eat the others, and you too ...

In anticipation of the full game, 3 additional scenes are expected.
This first scene already has some steam successes to unlock, others will come later.
A leaderboard is planned to challenge your friends.

Many imperfections are still present and this is where you come in, as BETA Testers, to chase away all these errors and problems so that the experience is even more fun!

Join our discord and sign up for the beta now, places are limited:
[b]https://discord.gg/FwMqzDB[/b]

You will of course be able to speak to the team and ask questions and make your remarks.
Hope to see you soon, i'm now returning back to my code !

See yah !
